Engineering Square | Multiple Roles | Los Angeles, CA & NYC | HYBRID | Full-Time

=== 1. Corporate/M&A Associate | Los Angeles, CA | $200K-$230K ===

Boutique law firm in West Los Angeles seeking a Corporate/M&A Associate for their middle-market M&A practice.

The firm advises on PE buyouts, strategic acquisitions, growth investments, and sell-side transactions across entertainment, tech, consumer, healthcare, and aerospace. They co-counsel with top firms and negotiate against Latham, Cooley, and Dentons on complex deals.

- Lean deal teams (partner + associate + paralegal) with real client exposure from day one - Draft/negotiate SPAs, APAs, LLC agreements, stockholder agreements, NDAs - 2-4 years corporate/M&A experience at BigLaw, strong midsize, or reputable boutique - JD from ABA-accredited law school, strong academics - Hybrid: up to 3 days remote. No visa sponsorship. - $200,000-$230,000 base + discretionary bonuses + generous raises

Apply: saikumar@engineeringsquare.us (subject: "M&A Associate - [Your Name]")

=== 2. Telecom Solution Engineer | New York, NY | $90/hr ===

Con Edison project — retiring legacy TDM/Channel Bank/POTS/T1 infrastructure and migrating to modern Ethernet/MPLS/fiber/wireless solutions.

- 12+ months contract, hybrid 2-3 days onsite at 4 Irving Place, NYC - Must have telecom engineering background with legacy-to-modern migration experience - GC/USC/GC EAD/H4 EAD/H1B welcome — must be local NYC

Apply: saikumar@engineeringsquare.us (subject: "Telecom Engineer - [Your Name]")
